# scripts/AISystem/GuardStation.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/AISystem/GuardStation.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Exclusive station used by GuardRota. World position is the standing point;
local -Z is facing. Kind selects sit/eat/sleep/rummage/carry/chop/lean or pray.
Optional chest/drop_to paths supply work targets. Claims store the holder Node directly.

Base: `Marker3D`. Registered class: `GuardStation`.
